articleTitle: A Graph-based Design and Programming Strategy for Reconfigurable Photonic Circuits
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We have developed a graph representation of programmable photonic mesh circuits that can be used by pathfinding algorithms. We modified the Dijkstra algorithm to observe only physically possible connections in the graph, demonstrating flexible rerouting in case of node malfunction.

articleTitle: Manipulating Free-space Optical Beams with a Silicon Photonic Mesh
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Photonic integrated meshes made of tuneable interferometers enable implementation of functions programmable on demand and are being envisioned as the optical counterpart of electronic field programmable gate arrays. Several examples of photonic processors capable of performing arbitrary linear operations have been recently proposed, and are expected to find applications in different areas, from the on-chip processing of telecom signals to microwave photonics, and from quantum optics to neural networks. In this work, we use a reconfigurable mesh of silicon photonic Mach-Zehnder Interferometers (MZIs) to manipulate free-space optical beams. We demonstrate beam steering, beam coupling from a free-space optical source to a single mode waveguide and automatic identification of the direction of arrival of a beam from a free-space source.

articleTitle: Evolution of Access Networks in the Era of Coherent Optics
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Implications of introducing coherent optics in access network architectures and supporting cellular connectivity, enterprise connectivity and residential capacity backhaul are discussed. The role of coherent optics technology in wired and wireless convergence and in the evolution of optical access networks is also reviewed.

articleTitle: Ubiquitous Coverage Next Generation Access Networks Based on Fiber/FSO Convergence with OBI-free Heterodyne Detection
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Challenges facing NGA networks are not only high speed, but also ubiquitous coverage. We propose and experimentally demonstrate a Fiber/FSO converged system to achieve this. With heterodyne detection, it can combat at least 5-dB loss fluctuation in FSO links and achieve OBI-free OFDM upstream transmission.

articleTitle: Transfer Learning for Nanophotonics
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We will discuss some new overlap between nanophotonics and artificial intelligence (AI). The first part focuses on the transfer learning method for nanophotonics design. The second part focuses on the potential application of 3D nanofabrication technology in deep learning circuits.

articleTitle: Integrated Photonic Outcoupling Array for Imaging-based Beam Steering
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Imaging-based beam steering (IBBS) utilizes a lens to relay focal-plane coordinates to line-of-sight (LOS) directions converting angular pointing into a position control problem. We introduce a photonic integrated circuit to dynamically route optical signals across a high-density outcoupler array for free-space optical communications using IBBS.

articleTitle: Photodetectors with Photon-trapping Surface Nanostructures for Short Range LIDAR Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Light trapping nanostructures implemented in PIN silicon photodetectors demonstrates more than 500% improvement of quantum efficiency at 905nm wavelength, enabling their implementation for short range, high resolution and low-cost LIDAR systems, required in new data driven applications such as robotics, agriculture and manufacturing.

articleTitle: Dual-Drive Directional Couplers for Programmable Integrated Photonics
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate the use of directional couplers with an independent phase actuator on each waveguide. We show the configurations that allow the setting of the splitting ratio and the phase in a silicon-nitride platform and their applications in programable photonic integrated circuits.

articleTitle: Reversible Gates for Programmable Photonics
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We present and develop a formalism for the implementation of complex programmable photonic circuits taking as basic building blocks 2×2 reversible gates corresponding to rotation operations. These gates isomorphically correspond to well-known photonic components.

articleTitle: Multi Tone Continuous Wave Lidar
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Multi-tone continuous wave LIDAR with interferometric detection will be presented. Experimental demonstrations of range finding and velocimetry measurements will be shown. Potential AI methods that can optimize the number of RF tones and provide high resolution ranging will be discussed.

articleTitle: High Speed and Low Latency PON for 5G Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: To meet the latency and bandwidth requirements of 5G mobile and residential/business services, high speed and low-latency PON is very an attractive solution. We review optical access technologies for 5G, and introduce recent feasibility demonstration.

articleTitle: Efficient Power-Division NOMA for Intelligent Optical Access Network Enabled by Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate both synchronized downlink and asynchronous uplink NOMA using deep learning techniques, providing expansibility for an ultra-dense network and enabling low-cost intelligent optical access network.

articleTitle: Coherent Technologies for Passive Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: To date, optical access networks have been exclusively based on intensity modulation with direct detection. However, recent advances in coherent transceivers offer the potential to overcome the many limitations of these systems. This work reviews such candidate technologies for low complexity coherent optical access networks.

articleTitle: Usage of the BB84 Protocol for Communications in Pairs of Orbiting Satellites
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We use the scheme of the BB84 protocol to estimate the Bit Error Rate (BER) between two satellites under the action of exchanging wireless communication inside the framework of the Internet of Space Things. The usage of the Bessel basis yields oscillations of BER curves.

articleTitle: Distributed Raman Amplification for Short-Reach Applications Including Passive Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We study Raman Amplification for short-reach systems. The impact of system parameters, including feeder length and discrete losses are reported. Our measurements focus on the NG-PON2 upstream band, but are extensible to other optical bands, including O-band.

articleTitle: Photontorch: Simulation and Optimization of Large Photonic Circuits Using the Deep Learning Framework PyTorch
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We propose a new framework for simulating and optimizing large photonic circuits. The framework utilizes gpu-acceleration to efficiently simulate the circuits in a highly parallel manner, while optimization is achieved through backpropagation by essentially viewing the network as a sparsely connected recurrent neural network.

articleTitle: Si-compatible Mid-infrared Photodetectors Based on 2D Materials
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We study 2D materials embedded in Si compatible nanostructures for mid-infrared photodetectors. The structures use nanoholes to trap light and embedded graphene layers. It was shown that optimization can significantly increase absorption and extend operating wavelength region.

articleTitle: FTT-5G Networks: Low-Latency FiWi Enhanced Mobile Networks With Edge Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We review the value of convergence in a common transport platform in a FTTH and small-cell roll-out scenario, including wireless access via WiFi, in support of future 5G low-latency applications. We highlight the added value of edge intelligence for the real-time transmission of haptic information.

articleTitle: Modulation Properties of 2x1 Coherently Coupled VCSEL Arrays
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: The analysis and characteristics of photonic crystal coherently coupled 2x1 VCSEL arrays are reported.

articleTitle: Chip Based THz Emitter for Ultra-high Speed THz Wireless Communication
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: By using a monolithically integrated dual-distributed feedback (DFB) laser chip attached to a photomixing uni-travelling carrier photodiode (UTC-PD) with a THz antenna, a single-channel THz photonic-wireless transmission system with a net rate of 131 Gbit/s over a wireless distance of 10.7 m has been achieved.

articleTitle: Analysis of Mode Locking in Quantum Dot Laser Diodes: a Time-Domain Travelling-Wave Approach
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We present a review of the most recent techniques for the analysis and the numerical simulation of mode locking in edge emitting and ring Quantum Dot laser diodes, in both single section (spontaneous mode locking) and two-section (active and passive mode locking) configurations.

articleTitle: High-performance III-V/Si Phase Shifter Arrays for Beam Steering
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: A high-performance III-V/Si phase shifter with a Vπ of 0.45 V and residual amplitude modulation of only 0.15 dB is reported. We are able to integrate the phase shifter in a dense configuration for optical phased arrays with a pitch of 4 μm, and demonstrate beam steering.

articleTitle: High-speed Visible Light Communication Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We summarize the latest research progresses applying machine learning in VLC systems. 2.7Gbit/s CAP64 VLC transmission based on a high-power 1-Watt phosphorescent white LED over 1.2m-free-space is demonstrated. As far as we know, this is the highest data rate using a high-power phosphorescent white LED.

articleTitle: Low Coherence Flexible Perovskite Random Lasers
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We demonstrated perovskite random lasers on the flexible polyimide substrates. The curvature of the perovskite thin film can be applied to optimize the laser action properties. Due to the low spatial coherence, the perovskite random lasers exhibited excellent characteristics for low speckle imaging.

articleTitle: Digital Coherent PON Technology for 100G to 1T Based Optical Access Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We review the recent progress of 100 Gb/s to 1 Tb/s class coherent passive optical network (PON) technology, highlighting recent work on using hardware-efficient DSP for coherent PON, especially simplified adaptive equalization (AEQ) and carrier phase recovery (CPR) in the receiver DSP.

articleTitle: Unstable Emission from Random Lasers
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Random lasers are unique optical systems where lasing occurs due to repetitive scattering in a disordered nanostructure with gain. Herein, self-consistent time-dependent random laser theory will be used to derive criteria leading to unstable, irreproducible emission from random lasers.

articleTitle: Neuromorphic Silicon Photonics on Foundry and Cryogenic Platforms
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Silicon photonics presents an opportunity for complex, multi-purpose information processing with optoelectronics. Using foundry devices, some photonic neural networks support sub-nanosecond signals. Using cryogenic devices, others support single-photon signals. We compare these platforms and summarize recent experimental results on programmability in photonic neurons and networks.

articleTitle: Mid-Infrared Trace Gas Sensing Using Photonic Crystal Waveguides
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Photonic crystals offer an ideal platform for on-chip absorption spectroscopy through engineering and enhancing light matter interaction. Using photonic crystal waveguides, we experimentally demonstrate parts per million and parts per billion level detection of different gas species.

articleTitle: Neuromorphic Photonic Processor Applications
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Reconfigurable photonic processors promise orders of magnitude improvements in both speed and energy efficiency over digital electronics for applications in neuromorphic computing and machine learning. We will provide an overview of neuromorphic photonic systems and their application to optimization and machine learning problems.

articleTitle: Probing Ultrafast Switch-on Dynamics of Frequency Tuneable Semiconductor Lasers Using Terahertz Time-domain Spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We report measurements of switch-on dynamics, mode competition and frequency selection in a monolithic frequency-tuneable laser using coherent time-domain sampling of the laser emission. We observe hopping between lasing modes on picosecond-timescales and temporal evolution of transient multi-mode emission into steady-state single mode emission.

articleTitle: Mid-infrared Applications of SiGeSn Optoelectronic Chips
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: The emerging SiGeSn heterostructure photonics technology has its roots in my early silicon-photonics results (1985-1991) and SiGeSn bandgap theory (1991). I shall review the real and potential applications of SiGeSn OE chips in the 2 to 5 micron range, monolithic chips hopefully for foundry manufacture.

articleTitle: Enhanced Chaotic Performance with Optically Injected Quantum Cascade Lasers
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Quantum cascade lasers, which are able to emit deterministic chaotic patterns, are found to exhibit improved chaos properties when using optical injection instead of conventional optical feedback. These findings are of paramount importance for developing high-speed secure communications in the mid-infrared domain.

articleTitle: Experimental Quantum Process Tomography of Controlled-phase Gate for Time-bin Qubits
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We demonstrate a controlled-phase gate for time-bin qubits using a 2 × 2 electro-optic switch based on lithium niobate waveguides. We reconstructed the process matrix using quantum process tomography with 16 distinct inputs from which we determined a process fidelity of 82%.

articleTitle: Development of GeSn Emitters and Detectors towards Integrated Mid-Infrared Photonics Applications
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: GeSn lasers and detectors have been investigated. For laser, the maximum operation temperature of 270 K and wavelength of 3.5 m were achieved; for detector, spectral cutoff was measured at 3.6 m. The broad wavelength coverage suggests the great potential applications in integrated midinfrared photonics.

articleTitle: Yagi-Uda Nanoantenna Structures for Infrared Detection Using Silicon
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Detection of light below band gap energies using nanolithographic Yagi-Uda antennas is discussed. Two nonlinear mechanisms contributing to generation of photocurrent are identified and evaluated. Results of a Si near-IR photodetector are presented and application to mid-IR discussed. Additionally, finite element modeling methods are employed.

articleTitle: Integrated Nanophotonics Enabled Residue Number System (RNS) Arithmetic
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Here we show a nanophotonic RNS arithmetic implementation by spatiallyshifting the input waveguides relative to a crossbar routers' outputs, where themoduli are represented by the number of waveguides. This highly parallelizablein-the-network kernel processes information at 10's of ps suitable forreal-time computing.

articleTitle: Tolerant, Broadband Tunable 2 × 2 Coupler Circuit
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We designed and demonstrated a coupler circuit with tunability for arbitrary coupling ratio and being tolerant to process errors. We also demonstrate that the circuit can be tuned to a uniform coupling spectrum over a 50~nm spectral bandwidth.

articleTitle: Interband and Quantum Cascade Laser Frequency Combs: From Physics to Monolithic Integration
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Interband and quantum cascade lasers are ideal sources to realize compact mid-infrared sensing instruments. Here, we present recent findings on the generation of optical frequency combs. Combined with their inherent detection capabilities, this technology paves the way towards monolithically integrated dual-comb spectrometers.

articleTitle: Performing Linear Operations Using Optical Complex Media
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We propose using complex media as platforms to build any linear operator using wavefront shaping. We demonstrate that system composed of multimode fiber and spatial light modulator can act like any linear operator and can be reconfigured at will. We experimentally performed several 16×16-single-shot operations.

articleTitle: Self-configuring Photonic Architectures and Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: By combining complex meshes of interferometers with photodetectors and simple feedback loops, sophisticated photonic systems can configure and stabilize themselves without calibration, and can be directly, progressively and adaptively trained to perform arbitrary linear functions. Key architectures and algorithms will be introduced and explained.

articleTitle: Growth of GeSn/Ge Superlattices by Remote Plasma-Enhanced Chemical Vapor Deposition
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Superlattices of GeSn/Ge were grown at 290 <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">ο</sup>C on Ge substrates by remote plasma enhanced chemical vapor deposition, using GeH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> and SnCl<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> precursors. The structural and optical properties of these layers were characterized by x-ray diffraction, and room temperature photoluminescence.

articleTitle: Realization of High-Q Microring Resonators with Single Crystal Aluminum Nitride
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We demonstrate microring resonators with high-Q using single crystal aluminum nitride directly grown on sapphire substrate. Initial measurement results show a Q-factor of 75, 000 at 770 nm and up to 1,100,000 at 1550 nm.

articleTitle: Low-cost and High-speed Nanophotonic Integrated Circuits for Access Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Ever-increasing data traffic demands higher-speed and lower-cost photonic integrated circuits (PICs) for the access network. Nanophotonic ICs on a thin membrane provide a promising solution with high density, enhanced speed and reduced assembly cost through co-integration with electronics. We present our recent developments on an InP nanophotonic membrane integrated on silicon.

articleTitle: Intensity Spread Analysis of Programmable Photonic Circuits with Parasitics
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Small stochastic imperfections in the phase and coupling (<; 1%) of tunable components in programmable photonics circuits introduce unwanted interferences deteriorating their frequency response. Performing Monte-Carlo simulations, we investigate such imperfections for different routings of light through a 7-cells hexagonal mesh with different biasing schemes.

articleTitle: Photon Statistics of Lasers Under External Perturbations: Impact of Nonlinear Dynamics
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: The impact of laser gain and external perturbations on the emitted photon statistics is investigated using a semi-classical Langevin approach. We evaluate photon auto-correlation functions from stochastic simulations and show that anti-bunching signatures can occur for classical light-fields due to nonlinear dynamics.

articleTitle: Future Roads for Group-IV Defect-enhanced Quantum Dot Light-emitters for Silicon Photonics
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Optical and optoelectronic properties of all-group-IV quantum dot light-emitters for which the optical properties are enhanced by in-situ implantation of heavy ions (DEQDs) are investigated. Research directions towards more efficient light-emission from DEQDs as well as considerations towards the microstructural investigation of DEQD-defects are elaborated.

articleTitle: Mid-infrared Sensing with Ge on Si Waveguides
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Ge-on-Si waveguides with losses below 5 dB/cm across 7.5 to 11 μm wavelength are demonstrated. Sidewall etch roughness was measured using atomic force microscopy to investigate the waveguide loss mechanisms. Mid-infrared spectroscopy of poly(methyl methacrylate) was demonstrated using the Ge waveguides for mid-infrared sensing.

articleTitle: Cable Operator's Access Architecture from Aggregation to Disaggregation and Distributed
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: This paper tracks the cable industry's road from disaggregated centralized access layer network element functions like separate layer 2 CMTS, routers, and edge QAM equipment to the aggregation of combining CMTS and router functions to disaggregated centralized Modular Headend Architecture to the complete aggregation of nearly all centralized access layer equipment and functions like CMTS, eQAM, PON, routers in a single element called Integrated-CCAP (I-CCAP) to the complete disaggregation of nearly all access layer equipment and functions with the Remote PHY Architecture and Flexible MAC Architecture.

articleTitle: Epitaxial Design of GeSn Quantum Wells for Optoelectronic Applications
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Epitaxial designs of GeSn/SiGeSn quantum wells for optoelectronic applications are theoretically demonstrated based on many-body theory. Layer structures for high-temperature operation lasers and electroabsorption modulators are discussed.

articleTitle: Discretization Effects of Digital Control of Thermally Tunable 2×2 MZI Couplers
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We describe how digital voltage driving of tunable 2×2 Mach-Zehnder couplers with thermo-optic phase shifters introduces discretization errors which significantly affect programmable photonic circuits. Performing quantitative analysis, we show that proper biasing of couplers and simultaneous driving of arms can improve discretization errors.

articleTitle: Ultra-high Capacity Wireless Communication Enabled by Photonic Technologies
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Recent research activities in optically-supported wireless communication and their prospects for meeting the explosively growing demand for wireless connectivity will be discussed, including dynamic radio pico-cell network architectures, optically-controlled radio beam steering, spatial division multiplexed OAM radio channels, and ultra-high capacity beam-steered optical wireless communication.

articleTitle: Multimode Fiber Based Single-shot Full-field Temporal Measurement
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We demonstrate a single-shot temporal measurement technique based on a multimode fiber. The complex spatiotemporal speckle field created by a known pulse propagating through the fiber interferes with an unknown signal. From the time-integrated interference pattern, both amplitude and phase of the signal are retrieved.

articleTitle: Quantum Walks in Quasi-Periodic Photonics Lattices
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We present construction rules for a new class of quasi-periodic photonics lattices to realize localized quantum walks deterministically. The new quasi-periodic structures are constructed symmetrically with Fibonacci, Thue-Morse sequences. Our simulations show that localized quantum walks in these quasi-periodic lattices are symmetrical and highly controllable.

articleTitle: Spontaneous Mode Locking and Frequency Comb Generation in a Quantum-dot Laser
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: A theory is presented for mode-locked quantum-dot lasers used in time- and wavelength-division multiplexing in telecommunications. Multimode semiclassical laser theory is used to treat active-medium nonlinearities resulting in mode competition, gain saturation, carrier-induced refractive index, and combination tones leading to spontaneous mode-locking and frequency-comb creation.

articleTitle: Neuromorphic Photonics with Laser Dynamics
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We report on the activation, inhibition and propagation of controllable neuron-like spiking signals at sub-nanosecond speeds (>7 orders of magnitude faster than neurons) in artificial optical neurons based upon Vertical-Cavity Surface-Emitting Lasers. These results offer great prospects for future ultrafast photon-enabled neuromorphic computing platforms.

articleTitle: Quantum Dot Tunable Photonic Oscillators
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We will review a series of experimental and theoretical findings spanning ten years of research on tunable photonic oscillators using optically-injected quantum-dot lasers as the slave (or follower) element. The particularly unique features of the quantum dot system will be discussed.

articleTitle: Beyond 50 Gb/s Directly-Modulated Long-Wavelength VCSELs for Next-Gen Access Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: The employment of long-wavelength directly-modulated VCSELs for applications in next-generation access networks is proposed. Suitable simulations are shown in case of DMT modulation and SSB filtering, demonstrating the capabilities of LW-VCSEL for future 50-Gb/s access networks.

articleTitle: Novel Integrated Platforms for Mid-infrared Photonics
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: All-silicon membrane waveguides, with air cladding layers, are promising candidates for linear- and nonlinear-optic applications in the mid-infrared. Two variations of the photonic platform, namely suspended- and anchored-membranes, have been demonstrated. Studies on supercontinuum generation and stimulated Brillouin scattering in the devices are presented.

articleTitle: Analysis of Franz-Keldysh Effect in GeSn Alloys
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We present a study of Franz-Keldysh effect in GeSn alloys for mid-infrared photonic applications. The electric-field-dependent absorption coefficient of GeSn alloys with different Sn compositions are calculated and discussed.

articleTitle: Planning and Dimensioning of Optical Transport Networks for 5G and Beyond
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: This paper presents the optimal planning frameworks that have been developed to jointly plan and dimension next generation mobile networks such as 5G and its optical transport network considering the deployment costs, existing infrastructures, and other network requirements including coverage, user capacity and transport bandwidth.

articleTitle: Antiresonances, Ultrafast Resonances and Exeptional Points in Twin Photonic Oscillators
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: In this talk we will cover the properties of the small-signal modulation response of symmetrybreaking phase-locked states of twin coupled semiconductor lasers. The extended stability and the varying asymmetry of these modes allows for the introduction of a rich set of interesting modulation response features, such as sharp resonances and antiresonances as well as efficient modulation at very high frequencies exceeding the free running relaxation frequencies by orders of magnitude. And show the abundance of exceptional points in the generic asymmetric configuration of two coupled diode lasers under nonzero optical detuning and differential pumping. We pinpoint the location of these points with respect to the stability domains and the Hopf bifurcation points of phase-locked modes, in the solution space as well as in the space of experimentally controlled parameters. Time permitting we will discuss the implications of these theoretical findings of small systems in coherently coupled vertical cavity laser diode arrays.

articleTitle: Partial Local Atomic Ordering in Ge-Sn Alloy
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: An underlying assumption in understanding the properties of group IV alloys is that atoms are randomly distributed within lattice sites. Here we show, by combining density functional theory calculation and Monte Carlo sampling, that a partial local atomic ordering exists in GeSn alloy.

articleTitle: Spatio-temporal Correlations in Multimode Fibers for Pulse Delivery
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We discover spatiotemporal intensity correlations for an optical pulse propagating through multimode fibers with random mode coupling. Positive long-range correlations arise from multiple scattering in fiber mode space. By optimizing the incident wavefront of a pulse, we maximize the power transmitted at a selected time.

articleTitle: Long-range Distribution of Multiphoton Entanglement
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We show that a long-distance quantum communication can be based on multiphoton bipartite entanglement and photon-number-resolved detection, the resources provided by the current quantum-photonic technology. The protocol is robust to high transmission losses and offers near-maximally entangled states in realistic implementations.

articleTitle: Advances in Neuromorphic Silicon Photonics
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Neuromorphic photonics is an emerging field at the nexus of photonics andneuroscience, which combines the advantages of optics and electronics. We will look at challenges of photonic information processing, describe photonic neural-network approaches, and offer a glimpse at this field's future.

articleTitle: The New World of Programmable Photonics
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Programmable photonics defines the technologies to manipulate light under software control on a microscopic scale, often on a photonic integrated circuit, offering the optical equivalent of field-programmable-gate-arrays in electronics. Programmable photonics enables uniquely new applications, but can also make the photonic ecosystem more widely accessible.

articleTitle: A Tunable Optical Filter Based on the Electrowetting Controlled Sagging Effect of a Liquid Droplet on a Superhydrophobic Substrate Embedding a Waveguide Bragg Grating
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: A tunable optical filter combining a waveguide Bragg grating and the electrowetting controlled sagging effect of a liquid droplet is proposed. A tuning range above 40 nm with a bandwidth of 0.6 nm is achieved.

articleTitle: Photonic MEMS: Exploiting Mechanics at the Micro- and Nanoscale for Efficient Reconfiguration of Photonic Integrated Circuits
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We exploit Micro- & Nano-Electro-Mechanical Systems in Photonic Integrated Circuits to perform basic photonic operations, including phase shifting, attenuation and switching. Due to their small footprint and low insertion loss, Photonic MEMS are highly scalable, while mechanical latching mechanisms can offer zero steady state power consumption.

articleTitle: Visible Light Communication and Ranging System Using High-speed Stereo Cameras
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We will introduce an integrated system of visible light communications (VLC) and ranging using high-speed stereo imaging. The system simultaneously decodes VLC signal while its source tracking portion outputs range information.

articleTitle: Strongly Injection-Locked Whistle-Geometry Microring Lasers for Optical Communications at 100 GHz and Beyond
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Large-signal analog modulation of strongly injection-locked single and cascaded whistle-geometry semiconductor ring lasers is analyzed. Advantages of strong injection locking for high-fidelity large-signal modulation are confirmed through numerical modeling.

articleTitle: Exploiting Programmable and Reconfigurable Hardware in 5G
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: The Open Computing Language (OpenCL) is increasingly adopted for programming processors with reconfigurable hardware acceleration. The 5G telecommunication infrastructure, imposing strong latency constraints, may benefit from OpenCL-designed accelerated processing. This work presents an evaluation of OpenCL hardware acceleration in the context of a 5G base station physical layer.

articleTitle: On-chip Generation, Coherent Control and Processing of Complex Entangled Photon States
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We demonstrate the on-chip generation of time-bin entangled two- and multi-photon qubit states, as well as high-dimensional frequency-entangled photon pairs. Combining time and frequency entanglement, we generate high-dimensional optical cluster states and implement proof-of-concept high-dimensional one-way quantum computing. This, by using standard, fiber-based telecommunication components.

articleTitle: Photoluminescence From GeSn Layers Fabricated Using Ion Implantation and Pulsed Laser Melting
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: Room temperature photoluminescence (PL) was observed from GeSn layers fabricated by ion implantation of Sn into bulk Ge followed by pulsed laser melting using an Nd:YAG laser at 355 nm. PL measurements indicate regions of high-crystalline quality with Sn concentrations of up to 9%.

articleTitle: On-chip Scalable Integrated Quantum Photonic Networks based on Quantum Dot Single Photon Source Array Integrated with Dielectric Light Manipulating Circuits
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We discuss integrated quantum photonic networks with arrays of spectrally uniform single quantum dots as single photon sources embedded with all-dielectric Mie resonance based light manipulating metastructures whose single dominant mode is exploited to provide all needed light manipulating functions towards optical quantum information processing.

articleTitle: GeSn Mid-infrared Nanophotonic Resonant Absorbers
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We have synthesized mid-infrared photonic crystals consisting of GeSn/Ge core/shell nanowires, combining e-beam lithography and VLS growth. Absorption spectra are tunable by changing the wire radius and spacing. We observed room temperature photocurrent spectra from the nanowire arrays at 1.4 μm to 2 μm wavelength.

articleTitle: MC4.3 -Optically Coupled Mode-Locked Laser Array for Spectroscopy in InP Generic Integration
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We propose a two-element mode-locked laser array operating at 1.56 μm. Optical pulses with 14.5-ps width, spectral bandwidth exceeding 7 nm, and RF line width of 260 kHz at 12.448 GHz are experimentally reported.

articleTitle: Investigating the Limits of Semicoductor Laser Based Optical Frequency Combs
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We investigate the limits of the output characteristics of semiconductor laser diode based optical frequency combs. We utilize novel cavity engineering approaches, along with novel gain media, to identify the physical parameters the affect the total number of combs, comb linewidth and potential for self-stabilization.

articleTitle: Narrow-Gap HgTe Colloidal Quantum Dot Infrared Photodetectors
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: HgTe colloidal quantum dots (CQDs) are solution-processed, spectrally-tunable infrared materials for next-generation short- and mid-infrared photodetectors. Photodiodes with p-on-n and n-on-p architectures achieve room temperature specific detectivities >10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</sup> Jones below 2.5 μm and up to 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">9</sup> Jones at 4 μm with background-limited photodetection upon cooling.

articleTitle: Nanowire and Superlattice Mid-Infrared Emitters on Silicon
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: We present 6.1 Å mid-infrared superlattice light emitters on (100) Si that outperform those on GaSb, and mid-infrared (wurzite) nanowires grown on (111) Si with favorable emitter characteristics, including Auger coefficients an order of magnitude smaller than comparable planar (zinc blende) materials.

articleTitle: Dynamics of Quantum Dot Lasers on Silicon
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE Photonics Society Summer Topical Meeting Series (SUM)
abstract: InAs/GaAs quantum dot lasers epitaxially grown on silicon substrates are promising candidates as light sources for silicon photonic integrated circuits. We discuss their dynamic properties via small-signal and pulsed simulation and experiment, with a special focus on their potential for data transmission applications.
